definitions.explanation: A strong prohibition, often seen on signs and in rules. Stronger than 禁止, conveying zero tolerance.

examples.japanese: {撮影|さつえい}{厳禁|げんきん}。
この{地域|ちいき}では{火気|かき}の{使用|しよう}が{厳禁|げんきん}されている。
examples.english: The use of open flames is strictly prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{以外|いがい}の{立|た}ち{入|い}りは{厳禁|げんきん}となっております。
examples.english: Entry is strictly prohibited for anyone other than authorized personnel.

notes:
{厳禁|げんきん} is stronger than {禁止|きんし} (prohibited). It implies zero tolerance and potentially severe consequences.

COMMON SIGN PATTERNS:
- {撮影|さつえい}{厳禁|げんきん}: photography strictly prohibited
- {飲酒|いんしゅ}{厳禁|げんきん}: alcohol strictly forbidden
- {喫煙|きつえん}{厳禁|げんきん}: smoking strictly forbidden
- {火気|かき}{厳禁|げんきん}: open flames strictly prohibited
- {立|た}ち{入|い}り{厳禁|げんきん}: entry strictly prohibited

CONTRAST:
- {禁止|きんし}: prohibited (standard level)
- {厳禁|げんきん}: strictly prohibited (stronger, zero tolerance)

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
Not to be confused with {現金|げんきん} (cash), which has the same reading but different kanji.
